answer: Cross-host timing audits make duplication self-revealing. Each identity must sign a random wander task timed against its local clock, so reused hosts show correlated residuals. A daily photo of a juniper sprig tied to claimed location reveals copied camera hardware. A probe with an opal sample tests sensor variation; an attacker pays one dedicated device, separate network exit, and operator time per identity, plus a 200-unit manual-review fee.
